tables.description: Unknown top-up outcomes and Shahab behavior

executable_decisions.decision: If debit outcome is unknown, do not claim failure; reconcile and show history; credit only once on valid receipt; definite failure adds no credit; return is separately tracked; unresolved discrepancy opens traceable case; no waiting 72 hours to query and no generic 72-hour refund promise
Use reliable identifiers and idempotent/persistent uniqueness so duplicate confirmations, return, inquiry, reconciliation cannot create a second wallet credit

Personal top-up minimum 10,000 IRR and account cap 200m IRR / rolling 24h; organizational minimum 1m and cap 1bn shared across gateway and bank transfer; route/date changes do not reset; pending requests count and definite failures release; over-cap receipts are held for review; numeric/operational handling remains open

Prepayment formal invoice required for organizations through gateway or bank transfer; link invoice to request and target wallet; invoice itself creates no money/credit; legal/tax details and correction/void handling remain open; no unsupported universal no-invoice claim
Gift code creates wallet credit; discount code lowers eligible price and creates no balance; calculate discounted price first; discount reuse after cancellation remains open

Campaign supports configured gift/audience/account/service/activation and spend deadline/usage counts/budget/status; examples are not universal fixed rules; concurrent budget and activation count must be guarded

Three optional independent gift limits: amount per payment, share of final price, period cap; all active limits apply jointly, aggregate gift-share cap prevents multiple gifts bypass, and use cannot exceed actual balance or residual cap capacity

Activation deadline and spending expiry are separate; spending can be fixed date, duration from activation or no expiry; exact time/timezone must be explainable; ordinary transfer does not reset expiry; numeric reserve deadline per service remains open
Cash and gift payment allowed; initially one wallet pays; payment source chosen before start; pricing is dynamic and exact processing metric deferred

Reservation earmarks funds for a specific operation, is not final consumption/revenue/bank transfer, and cannot be spent/transferred/withdrawn; preserve cash/gift provenance; release differs from refund
Initial estimate and increase cap approved before service; staged reservation covers next stage, not total estimate; insufficient eligible funds blocks start; do not compound cap at each stage

Service-specific deadline applies before start/user wait; controlled execution extension requires real progress and max service duration; unknown external cost stops new cost and only exposed amount stays reserved until resolution; release rest when no obligation; no universal numeric deadline
